project.name: AI-Powered Customer Support Backend
project.description: FastAPI + PostgreSQL support-ticket backend used as the Applied AI Engineering starter project. Students implement ticket APIs, authorization, LLM summarization, retrieval, safe tool use, and evaluation.

tasks.title: Implement ticket creation REST API
tasks.description: Create POST /tickets with request validation, persistence, and proper status codes. Return the created ticket with id and timestamps.

tasks.title: Add authorization to ticket access
tasks.description: Ensure students can only access their own tickets. Add ownership checks to GET/PATCH ticket endpoints and cover negative-access cases.

tasks.title: Integrate LLM ticket summarization
tasks.description: Add a summarization endpoint that calls the LLM provider behind a typed interface and returns structured output with error handling for provider failures.

criteria: Does not leak prompt or keys

tasks.title: Add retrieval over support knowledge base
tasks.description: Index support articles and return relevant passages for a ticket query with relevance scoring.

tasks.title: Add safe order lookup tool
tasks.description: Expose an order-lookup tool with permission checks, input validation, and audit logging. The tool must not expose other customers' orders.

tasks.title: Evaluation and monitoring
tasks.description: Add evaluation over a golden dataset, latency metrics, and a simple monitoring endpoint summarizing quality signals.
